# ARL6IP1 — plates

Back to [[ARL6IP1]]. Per plate, two 8 × 12 grids laid out as the plate (rows A–H, columns 1–12). **Raw CPM** = this gene's counts per million in the well, pooled over every cell line in it (`tensor/well_counts.npy` column 9971 ÷ `tensor/well_umi.npy` × 10⁶; uncorrected). **W2** = the corrected well effect (`atlas/effects/W2.npy` column 9971; log2; median over the lines of each line's change against its own baseline on the plate, composition- and position-corrected; 0 = a typical drug well). **Bold** = DMSO well; · = no analysed well. Which drug and dose is in each well: the Plate notes.
